channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Spanish footballer Jesus de Miguel mourned by family and friends
item.description: The 30-year-old striker suffered cardiac arrest following an on-field collision.

item.title: Saudi coalition intercepts missile fired towards Medina
item.description: Interception comes after Saudi civil defence agency warned of potential danger near the strategic port of Yanbu.

item.title: Mass protests in France driven by nationwide strike action
item.description: More than 250,000 people took to the streets across France on Thursday as five unions called a day of strike action.

item.title: Iran says tankers struck in Hormuz amid fears of new US attack
item.description: Iranian forces say five oil tankers and a tugboat have caught fire in several incidents in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Jordanian officer killed in stabbing attack in Amman
item.description: A Jordanian security officer has been killed and another one wounded near the Sri Lankan embassy in Amman.

item.title: Who could be behind hoax bomb threats to European air travel?
item.description: There is no hard evidence so far linking airline bomb threats to Russia, Iran or any proxy groups.

item.title: Eight killed in series of shootings in western Turkey
item.description: Victims are found in several locations in three separate vehicles, according to local reports.

item.title: Pope Leo hosts Bob Dylan at official residence in Rome
item.description: Pope Leo had previously quoted Dylan's work in the preface of a book warning against nuclear rearmament.

item.title: Vance walks Trump tightrope with scathing election critique blaming Iran war
item.description: The vice-president's blunt assessment of Republican election defeat marked one of the sharpest breaks with a sitting president in recent memory.
